overview_description.description: Termius lets the user to organize hosts into groups. Groups allow to share settings, though each host can have its own separate preferences. This data, along with connection and command history, is securely synced across all your devices. Termius uses end-to-end encryption to ensure the data remains safe and secure.

about_short_description.short_description: Termius allows the user to organize hosts into groups, using end-to-end encryption to ensure the data remains safe and secure.

product.name: Termius Modern SSH Client
product.description: A cross-platform SSH client that manages and organizes SSH connections with features like autocomplete, multi-tab terminals, and split view.

product.name: Vault
product.description: An end-to-end encrypted cloud storage system for securely storing and syncing SSH data across devices and teams.

product.name: Keychain
product.description: A centralized management system for SSH keys, passwords, and identities, supporting key generation and secure authentication.

product.name: API Bridge
product.description: A Docker-based REST API that encrypts and synchronizes infrastructure data with Termius Vault for automated host management.
